description: This PHP class handles transformations of width/height length attributes into CSS style declarations, converting numeric values into pixel units and injecting them into CSS styles.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Length
classes.description: A class for transforming length attributes (such as width and height) to CSS style declarations, primarily used in sanitizing HTML to ensure CSS is properly applied.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute name and equivalent CSS property name.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms an attribute by appending its length value with 'px' if it's a digit and prepends it as CSS style.
